t: Overlooking Bank junction, outside the Royal Exchange, is the equestrian statue of the Duke of Wellington. Francis Leggatt Chantrey was the sculptor. He was the leading portrait sculptor of Regency Britain. The statue commemorates Wellington's help to the City of London in making sure a bill was passed to allow the rebuilding of London Bridge. Wellington was a soldier and statesman who served as Prime Minister and as Commander-in-Chief of the Forces. Henry Weekes, a successful Victorian sculptor, is also credited with making this statue.
